subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The class learned that online words move quickly, but trust returns slowly.”?
options: Deleting a post may remove words from a page, but not from people's memory.
Sometimes the nose opens memory faster than words.
Sometimes an object stops working as a tool and starts working as a memory.
It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The class learned that online words move quickly, but trust returns slowly. Deleting a post may remove words from a page, but…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes the nose opens memory faster than words.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes an object stops working as a tool and starts working as a memory.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The class learned that online words move quickly, but trust returns slowly. Deleting a post may remove words from a page, but not from…」，答案為「Deleting a post may remove words from a page, but not from people's memory.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Deleting a post may remove words from a page, but not from people's memory.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
